blocks.html: Close to the airport and key business districts, yet planned around landscaped open spaces and nature-inspired amenities, Woodsville Crest by RLC Residences pairs the convenience of life in southern Metro Manila with a greener, more relaxed residential setting.

Last September 2, that vision gained further momentum when RLC Residences, the residential division of Robinsons Land Corporation, topped off the Olive Building, the third tower launched at the mid-rise community in Merville, Parañaque. The milestone provides visible evidence of continued construction progress at the development as Woodsville Crest moves forward through its next stage.

At the topping-off ceremony, Engr. Emmanuel Arce, Vice President for Project Management of RLC Residences, described the milestone as a significant point in the project’s construction phase emphasized the continued work required to complete the development.

“Ceremonies like this have always been a welcome treat to us. It marks a major milestone in the construction phase of our development,” Arce said. “It reminds us that we should continue with our untiring efforts in the completion of the project and make our buildings a safe place to live in.”

Set on a 3.26-hectare property, Woodsville Crest is planned as an eight-building mid-rise community, offering residents ample space for recreation, wellness, and time outdoors while maintaining convenient access to major destinations across southern Metro Manila.

blocks.html: The property is accessible through West Service Road and Edison Avenue, with convenient connections to SLEX, Ninoy Aquino International Airport, Makati, and Bonifacio Global City. This can be particularly practical for aviation and airport employees, along with others whose work and routines keep them connected to the country’s main international gateway.

For balikbayans and Filipinos based overseas, Woodsville Crest can likewise serve as a convenient Metro Manila home base, given its proximity to NAIA and key destinations across the southern part of the metropolis.

Within the community, landscaped areas and recreational amenities provide places to unwind, exercise, and spend time outdoors. These include a swimming pool, picnic grove, wellness trail, pet-friendly spaces, and children’s play areas, extending the nature-inspired character of Woodsville Crest into residents’ everyday routines.

The homes themselves range from studios to executive two-bedroom configurations and incorporate smart features such as smart locks, smart lighting, and audio-video intercoms. Sustainability features, including EV charging stations, bike parking, and rainwater harvesting, complement the project’s approach to contemporary urban living.

With Olive now structurally complete, Woodsville Crest continues to take shape as a residential community that balances nature-inspired living with convenient access to key destinations across southern Metro Manila.
To learn more about Woodsville Crest and explore available units, visit rlcresidences.com or connect with an RLC Residences Property Specialist.
